sources.note: Main vendor homepage. Describes AdvancedMD as unified cloud-based EHR, PM, and patient engagement platform. South Jordan, Utah.
EHR product page. Marketing-focused, limited feature detail. Describes unified clinical care platform.
ONC mandatory disclosures/certification page. Mostly structural content; specific certification details not extractable via fetch.
Patient portal page. Describes appointment scheduling, prescription requests, health records access via secure portal.
Specialties page. Lists supported specialties with clickable icons (specific names not extractable, but confirmed broad multi-specialty support via search results).
AdvancedMD NOW product page. Simplified cloud platform for small mental health practices with teletherapy, billing automation, and practice workflows.
Mobile EHR app page. Companion app for on-the-go chart access, clinical documentation, and remote practice management.
Medical billing software page. Describes billing platform for faster payments and revenue maximization.
RCM page. Describes outsourced billing services, claims management, clearinghouse, A/R tracking.
Financial reporting page. Describes reporting dashboards with MTD, YTD, period comparisons, payer analytics.
Integrated fax page. Describes automated inbound/outbound fax with digital document management, e-signature, filing.
Document scanning module page. Describes scanning/importing documents, photos, insurance cards, consent forms into PM/EHR. TWAIN-compatible.
Patient self-scheduling page. Describes online appointment booking and scheduling management.
Company history page. Content not fully extractable but confirmed founding in 1999, evolution as medical practice billing service.
2025 Winter Release blog. Describes Patient Cards enhancements, AutoSave, population health reporting for MIPS, Bright Futures pediatric templates.
2025 press release. 65,000+ practitioners, 14,000+ practices, 900 billing companies. Record revenue/growth. Amanda Sharp CEO, Bryan Hunt CFO.
Blog post about Francisco Partners acquisition from Global Payments, closed late 2024.
Global Payments 2018 acquisition press release. $700M deal. AdvancedMD described as SaaS provider for 33,000 doctors, 11,000 practices.
Francisco Partners 2024 acquisition announcement. $1.125B deal. ~$250M expected revenue.
Payments Dive coverage of the $1.1B sale. Context on Global Payments divestiture strategy.
2018 acquisition coverage. AdvancedMD had 17,500 practitioners at 2015 Marlin Equity acquisition.
FindEMR product page. Good feature detail: Patient Cards, Task Donut, telehealth, e-prescribing, AI tools, integrations (Swell, HIPAA One, etc.). Pricing $169-700/provider/month.
